m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: The original Lord M7 I/J tested candidate SHA fd09cb26 matches Cory's exact October 25 approved 100; no candidate substitutions arose during owner approval. New 14-case owner-specific finite fixture CI at exact head 0d4c51d confirms source-bound scope. Historical I/J local optimum does not assert mathematical optimality or measured multiplayer performance.

P0.payable_fixture: Lord in command zone, U/B/R plus generic available; then remove R or fourth mana.
P0.positive_assertion: {1}{U}{B}{R} casts a 10/4 Zombie with the actual sacrifice/draw/regeneration Oracle.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No R or no total four mana fails the source-paid cast.

P0.payable_fixture: Resolve Lord enters with zero, one, two or three other creatures.
P0.positive_assertion: Losing 2 life and giving opponent two draws; two others sacrificed if available.
P0.adversarial_assertion: With fewer than two others, Lord himself must be sacrificed; own regeneration does not stop that.

P0.payable_fixture: Torpor Orb/Karn/Dress Down established before Lord enters; counters held when enters trigger is on stack.
P0.positive_assertion: Permanent suppression stops trigger formation; Stifle/Tale's End/Consign can counter a formed trigger.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Suppressor absent upon entry allows trigger; after trigger appears, suppression alone does not counter it.

P0.payable_fixture: Spend black for Lord's regenerate shield facing destruction/damage versus sacrifice or -X/-X.
P0.positive_assertion: Regeneration replaces destroy or lethal damage if otherwise legal.
P0.adversarial_assertion: It cannot replace sacrifice, exile, lethal toughness reduction.

P0.payable_fixture: Allow Lord trigger with 0/1/2 other creatures; compare to Torpor/Consign route.
P0.positive_assertion: Two other bodies pay the sacrifice and Lord survives; suppression avoids drawback entirely.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No adequate bodies without suppression sacrifices Lord; Feed is cut and cannot be counted.

P1.payable_fixture: Lord equipped with Greaves shroud or Regalia ward; attempt own targeted spell.
P1.positive_assertion: Regalia permits your own targeting; Greaves gives haste/shroud.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Own Tainted Strike, Pain for All or Ignition cannot target your shrouded Lord.

P1.payable_fixture: Rooftop Storm active, Zombie Lord cast at 0 alternative mana cost with commander tax.
P1.positive_assertion: Rooftop alternative cost may reduce printed mana to {0}; commander tax still applies 2 per previous cast.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Not a blanket bypass of commander tax or a zero-cost cast before Rooftop resolves.

P1.payable_fixture: Have Torpor/Karn/Dress Down or Stifle/Tale's End/Consign in the approved 100.
P1.positive_assertion: Six source-backed suppression/response pieces present to manage Lord enters.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Trigger not suppressed after the entry window simply by a later permanent.

P1.payable_fixture: Two cheap creature bodies; BMC changeling token and Ornithopter before Lord enters.
P1.positive_assertion: BMC and Ornithopter provide creature fodder; recursive creatures are present.
P1.adversarial_assertion: BMC token costs 3 life and Ornithopter cannot tap on entry without haste.

P1.payable_fixture: Lord with Phyresis/Tainted Strike deals ten infect combat damage to first opponent, Kediss to other opponents.
P1.positive_assertion: Ten poison counters defeat opponent; Kediss damage from Lord spreads infect.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without infect the damage is ordinary life loss; Kediss output is noncombat, not commander damage.

P1.payable_fixture: Uncaged Fury on base 10 power; compare double strike without +1; Ignition and Pain for All anchors.
P1.positive_assertion: 11 power x two connected strikes gives 22 combat commander damage.
P1.adversarial_assertion: 10 power x two is 20, not lethal 21; Ignition is not itself combat commander damage.

P1.payable_fixture: Gravecrawler in graveyard with another Zombie, an outlet and payable recast path.
P1.positive_assertion: Altar/Rooftop/Soultrader lines require actual another-Zombie presence and resource conditions.
P1.adversarial_assertion: No other Zombie or no graveyard Gravecrawler means the recursive cast line does not start.

P1.payable_fixture: Counter-removal choices with Terminate/Deadly Rollick/Chaos Warp and two sweepers.
P1.positive_assertion: Three listed targeted removal spells and two sweepers remain available.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Feed the Swarm and Sheoldred's Edict no longer answer opposing enchantments/untargetable threats.

P1.payable_fixture: Torpor Orb active alongside Skullclamp, Undead Augur and BMC.
P1.positive_assertion: Torpor suppresses enters-caused triggers, while death and main-phase abilities still function.
P1.adversarial_assertion: It must not be incorrectly treated as suppressing every triggered ability; Bowmasters not included.

limitations: 14 finite source-bound, payable/adversarial fixtures; no full Magic rules-engine game state simulation or multiplayer win rates. Historical Pass C owner-equivalent waiver remains non-independent; the 'independent_review_ref' is an adversarial ChatGPT review distinct from GrokBot research, not an independent third-model execution.
